exports.leonardoImageAdapter: default image adapter instance (guarded generate adapter, responseFormats [url])
exports.leonardoVideoAdapter: default video adapter instance (VIDEO_GENERATION_ADAPTERS contract, responseFormats [url])
exports.createLeonardoImageAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, maxPolls, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildLeonardoImageRequest: (model, body) -> { modelId, prompt, width, height, num_images: 1 }; throws status 400
exports.buildLeonardoVideoRequest: (model, body) -> { model, prompt, resolution, width, height, isPublic: false }; throws status 400
exports.resolveLeonardoImageModelId: catalog id -> platform-model UUID; UUID passthrough; empty -> phoenix
exports.resolveLeonardoImageSize: width/height, then WxH size, then 1024; bounded 32..1536, multiple of 8
exports.resolveLeonardoVideoModel: catalog id -> MOTION2 / MOTION2FAST; legacy phoenix -> MOTION2; upper-case enum passthrough
exports.resolveLeonardoVideoSize: source RESOLUTION_480 / RESOLUTION_720 and 2:3 / 4:5 portrait mapping
exports.runLeonardoJob: submit + bounded poll; { success, result, generationId } or error result with acceptedJob
exports.leonardoAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.leonardoPublicUrl: public https URL check used for results

notEquivalent.cloudflare-ai @cf/leonardo/*: Workers AI endpoint, Cloudflare auth and envelope; not the Leonardo REST API
notEquivalent.generic OpenAI image adapter: OpenAI body and synchronous data[] answer; Leonardo needs modelId UUID, width/height and a generation poll

models.dynamicDiscovery: none in the source; static lists. The source names GET /api/rest/v1/platformModels only as the origin of the two UUIDs.

notStaged.initImage: POST https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/init-image plus presigned S3 upload (source /v1/images/edits only)
